issue.body:
We need to release a new version based on Camel 3.18.0 LTS.

What are the issues you want to add as mandatory in 1.10.0? Please add the issues here, so we can track and start a release soon.

body:
Hi folks, I can still see the same error in my application:
```
2022-08-25 08:38:27,286 ERROR [org.apa.cam.qua.mai.CamelMainRuntime] (main) Failed to start application: org.graalvm.polyglot.PolyglotException: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate language id regex. First language [Language class com.oracle.truffle.regex.RegexLanguage, Loaded from file:/deployments/dependencies/lib/main/org.graalvm.regex.regex-22.1.0.jar]. Second language [Language class com.oracle.truffle.regex.RegexLanguage, Loaded from file:/deployments/dependencies/lib/main/org.graalvm.regex.regex-22.1.0.jar].
```
I have updated to quarkus `2.11.3.Final` and using still graalvm `22.1.0` (from builder image quay.io/quarkus/ubi-quarkus-native-image:22.1.0-java11). Is this configuration good or should I change something else?
@squakez not sure. A small Maven reproducer would help as Radim confirmed the PR fixed the issue for him.

Thanks for the comment. Unfortunately it's not an easy tasks, as we're building the application via Camel K, and that is the one in charge to transparently create the maven application. Exporting it is not very easy as well. I'll check to see how else I can reproduce it and let you know.

Ref https://github.com/apache/camel-k/issues/3560#issuecomment-1225740336

body: I think I managed to workaround the problem by mimicking the behavior in the `runnerParentFirstArtifacts`. Please have a look at https://github.com/apache/camel-k-runtime/pull/878. I've tested locally and it seems it fix the problem. I wonder if that same workaround should be applied directly to the Quarkus code base. Please, feel free to reuse it.
